## About the journal

## Aims & Scope

The _Journal of Controlled Release_ (JCR) is the Official Journal of the [Controlled Release Society](http://www.controlledreleasesociety.org/), and of the Japan Society of Drug Delivery System.

It publishes high-quality research articles in the broad field of **delivery science** and **technology**. This includes **drug delivery systems** and **all aspects of formulations**, such as physicochemical and biological properties of drugs, design and characterization of dosage forms, release mechanisms, _in vivo_ testing, and formulation research and development in the disciplines of pharmaceutical, diagnostic, agricultural, environmental, cosmetic, and food industries.

Manuscripts that advance fundamental understanding of principles and/or demonstrate advantages of novel technologies in safety and efficacy over current clinical standards will be given priority.
